carrier: Gauss Perron-Frobenius analytic/Hardy trace-class lane with digit perturbation L_t

khinchin_leading_riesz_pairing.derivative_identity: lambda_prime(0)=ell(L_prime_0 h)=sum_n p_n log n, p_n=log_2((n+1)^2/(n(n+2)))
khinchin_leading_riesz_pairing.guard: this closes the leading eigenvalue derivative only for the declared Gauss PF/digit perturbation carrier; no identification with unrelated weighted Riesz carriers is made
khinchin_leading_riesz_pairing.left_eigenfunctional: ell(f)=integral_0^1 f(x) dx; ell L_0=ell and ell(h)=1
khinchin_leading_riesz_pairing.projector_formula: P f=h*ell(f), so lambda_prime(0)=ell(L_prime_0 h) under the frozen normalization ell(h)=1
khinchin_leading_riesz_pairing.right_eigenfunction: h(x)=1/(log(2)*(1+x)); L_0 h=h by telescoping sum 1/((n+x)(n+x+1))

trL3.formula: for 3-branch orientation-reversing composition with matrix [[A,B],[C,D]], fixed x solves Cx^2+(D-A)x-B=0; q=(Cx+D)^-2; contribution=q/(1+q)
